distance_definition: Number of agent/user turns after the causal clue and before fast-forward; includes the evaluated pre-gap action and user acknowledgement.
clue: There are four hours between the flights in Denver.
clue_answer: the Denver connection time was four hours
clue_ablation_text: I am not sure; I do not have the rest of the itinerary available.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hi, I am checking on my flight to Denver this afternoon.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I see the two-fifteen departure. Is that the flight you mean?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes. I want to make sure everything is on track.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: A departure delay that is at least as long as the Denver connection window makes the onward flight impossible unless it is protected.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Understood; I have the connection time in front of me.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Do you have dietary or accessibility needs?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: No, nothing like that.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Is the rewards number ending in nine-nine-three yours?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, that is mine.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Do you need directions to the departure terminal?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: No, I know where to go.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Are you checking any bags?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Just one checked bag.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Would you like gate-change notifications by text?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, that would help.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Does anything else on the reservation look wrong?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: No, everything else looks right.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: How much connection time is scheduled in Denver?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: There are four hours between the flights in Denver.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Do you already have a seat assignment?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, fourteen C, an aisle.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: The security wait is about twenty minutes. Are you leaving soon?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, I am heading to the airport shortly.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Is the contact phone number on the booking current?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, it is current.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Enable active monitoring for changes to the itinerary.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, I will watch for what happens.

connection_status.at_risk_if_delayed: the connection is currently possible but a sufficiently long departure delay would break it
connection_status.missed: the departure delay is at least the layover time, so the planned connection cannot be made
connection_status.protected: confirmed protection/rebooking preserves the onward journey despite disruption
connection_status.viable: the planned connection remains feasible with the current timing

causal_alignment.misaligned: the connection window is shorter than the departure delay
causal_alignment.aligned: the connection window remains longer than the departure delay

pre_gap_actions.description: Enable active monitoring for changes to the itinerary.
Change the later segment immediately despite the current on-time status.
Replace the current departure even though it is still on time.
Offer disruption compensation before a disruption occurs.
Close the request without monitoring for changes.

post_gap_actions.description: Protect the later segment now and offer a compatible alternative.
Continue monitoring the existing itinerary without changing it.
Work only on the delayed departure and leave later segments unchanged.
Offer disruption compensation without changing the itinerary.
Confirm the delay and close the request.

causal_post_gap_observation.text: The departure is now delayed by 120 minutes, but the notice does not show my connection status. Based on the connection time I mentioned earlier, what should we do next?

response_styles.description: Briefly acknowledge the user's frustration or experienced impact before proceeding.
Acknowledge the time pressure and prioritize the immediate next step.
Briefly clarify the situation and reassure the user before proceeding.
Proceed directly and neutrally to the next operational step.

questions.question: How much connection time is scheduled in Denver?
questions.gold_answer: the Denver connection time was four hours

tag_definitions.EARLY_CLUE_LOSS: The selected action is attractive when the early clue is unavailable or unused.
tag_definitions.STATE_SYNC_FAILURE: The action treats the pre-gap world as if it still held after time advanced.
tag_definitions.TIME_INFERENCE_FAILURE: The action fails to use elapsed time when interpreting the observation.
tag_definitions.REPEATED_ACTION: The action repeats a step already attempted without a new justification.
tag_definitions.PREMATURE_CLOSE: The action closes an interaction whose state is unresolved.
tag_definitions.PREMATURE_ESCALATION: The action escalates before supported diagnostic or policy steps are exhausted.
tag_definitions.ACTION_SELECTION_FAILURE: The action is inconsistent with the current state but has no narrower failure label.
tag_definitions.PROSODY_GROUNDING_FAILURE: The response approach does not match the audible delivery.
tag_definitions.BELIEF_REPORT_INVALID: One or more required state-belief distributions or revalidation flags are missing or malformed.
tag_definitions.STATE_BELIEF_ERROR: At least one required checkpoint assigns its highest probability to the wrong hidden state.
